300church-harrington-de.assessment: Daniel Walton serves as teaching elder at 300CHURCH (formerly Harrington Baptist Church) in Harrington DE, a confessional 1689 Reformed Baptist congregation. Listed on ReformedReader DE directory and ReformedWiki as 1689-affirming. Sermons available via SermonAudio. Recommended for men seeking confessional Reformed Baptist preaching in central Delaware.

score_notes.gender: Complementarian/patriarchal — male elders only per RB practice

300church-harrington-de.pastor_credentials: Pastor John Hill: B.S. Geology (University of Pittsburgh); M.S. Mining Engineering (Penn State); seminary-level training through formal and informal study (per hbclife.net — site does not mention Daniel Walton)
